text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... hehe. How did I do, Big<n>Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... hehe. How did I do, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've gotten a lot better, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! Next up is the spring<n>Tenno Sho, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... I came by myself today... to show<n>my support.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You were spectacular, just like at the<n>Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Focusing on one goal and forging<n>ahead... You're
just like a hero<n>leading her people, worthy of being
memorialized in legend for<n>generations to come!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... I got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's okay. Sorry. But... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit embarrassing... but I'm<n>happy you said
that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I do want to become like the Blue<n>Rose of Good
Fortune, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! Do you remember the last<n>page?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of them talk excitedly about<n>the book all
the way back to campus.
